Department of Radiology
Date: 10 Jan 2025
Exam: mpMRI prostate

Clinical indication: Re-evaluation of prostate cancer. PSA 7.0 ng/mL. Prior biopsy Gleason 3+3.

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume: 40.49 mL. T2-weighted imaging demonstrates a focal lesion in the peripheral zone / transition zone at the apex/mid right, measuring approximately 12 mm. This lesion shows restricted diffusion on DWI (b=1400) with corresponding early enhancement on DCE sequences. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is seen. No suspicious lymph nodes or bone lesions.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right peripheral/transition zone apex/mid. PSA density 0.17 ng/mL/mL. Clinical stage cT1c. csPCa predicted probability 0.7916967.

previous_notes.text: 25 Jul 2023 - Dr. R. van den Berg (GP): Patient presented with elevated PSA of 2.3 ng/mL. DRE was normal. Discussed risks and benefits of prostate biopsy. Patient opted for biopsy. Referred to urology for further evaluation.

pathology_report:
Biopsy timepoint 1: Transrectal ultrasound-guided prostate biopsy. Histological examination reveals adenocarcinoma with Gleason score 3+3, corresponding to ISUP grade group 1. The tumour exhibits separate glandular tubules. No cribriform or intraductal patterns identified. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone / transition zone, apex/mid right. Overall trajectory across timepoints shows stable low-grade disease.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 3.
